from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiability(BaseModel):
    """One company's total current liabilities from the financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    total_current_liabilities: float | None = Field(description="Total current liabilities amount in yuan")
    currency: str | None = Field(default="元", description="The currency unit")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyLiability]
